description:
User approved review finding 3 and the proposed fix on 2026-11-28.

Problem: DeliveryConfirmation.record_attempt/3 skips empty failure evidence. After a rejected or timed-out delivery, a separate successful attempt on the same persisted answer leaves older delivery_parts in Engine. MessageDelivery presentation then labels the answer partial despite the newer confirmed attempt. Both failure-to-success and timeout-to-success were reproduced during review; success-first control passed.

Agreed behavior: scope displayed delivery status and failed parts to the current attempt. A fully successful newer attempt supersedes previous displayed failures while historical evidence remains separately available. Do not clear genuine partial failures belonging to the same attempt. Delayed older reports must not overwrite newer attempt status. Define and verify explicit attempt precedence; UUID identity or report arrival order alone must not be assumed chronological.

Ownership: Channels reports normalized attempt facts through existing DeliveryConfirmation -> Event/NodeRouter -> Engine. Engine owns persistence, attempt precedence and current presentation. Keep Plan, prepared requests, bytes, raw errors and policy execution Channels-local. Do not introduce a parallel history/reporting path or provider retries.

Files to inspect: lib/zaq/channels/delivery_confirmation.ex, lib/zaq/channels/delivery/result.ex, lib/zaq/engine/conversations/message_delivery.ex, existing delivery evidence and history ingress contracts. Choose the smallest coherent change that preserves confirmation idempotency and existing legacy confirmation behavior.

Tests: extend existing grouped-delivery/reporting tests and fixtures for failure -> success, timeout -> success, genuine same-attempt partial delivery, and delayed older reports. Assert persisted current attempt and UI presentation, not only intermediate reports. Preserve historical evidence and existing assertions; do not add duplicate fixture modules. User approval covers this new attempt-scoped behavior, not unrelated test weakening.

Action reuse assessment: extend existing reporter and Engine delivery evidence/presentation ownership. Reuse Event/NodeRouter dispatch, evidence validation, history ingress and existing persistence synchronization. No new Action, send path or provider logic. Verification through existing reporting, Engine grouped-delivery and relevant presentation tests.

Read AGENTS.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/testing-approach.md, docs/code-quality.md and relevant Channels/Engine service sections before implementation; documentation changes follow docs/documentation.md. Follow issue validation lifecycle and preserve current UX/E2E gates. This issue records the agreed fix while remaining findings are reviewed; no implementation performed in this decision turn.

comments.text: Boundary/Action reuse assessment rechecked: extend Result safe evidence and existing DeliveryConfirmation reporting, Engine DeliveryEvidence validation and MessageDelivery row-lock persistence/presentation. No new Action, send route or history association implementation. Attempt precedence will use explicit UTC start time captured before preparation/provider operations, never UUID order or completion/report arrival; strictly later starts supersede, equal or missing start facts cannot displace an ordered current attempt, and same-attempt conflicting terminal facts cannot clear genuine failures. Preserve earlier snapshots separately in private delivery_attempts metadata. Legacy confirmation and history idempotency remain authoritative and untouched; test actual Channels->Engine persisted presentation.

Regression evidence: new failure->success, timeout->success, delayed-success and tied/missing-time cases failed on original code. Focused implementation run passed 42 checks (5 properties, 37 tests). Broader run passed all 155 tests and 14/15 properties; the added permutation property exhausted uniqueness retries, corrected to StreamData.shuffle over the fixed domain. Subsequent mix q hit ExDNA internal 5-second task timeout; retrying unmodified check and full focused suite. Owning docs describe explicit UTC ordering/clock assumptions and immutable terminal snapshots. Supplemental .15 review regression prevents duplicate fallback after an independent answer is already reserved.

title: [zaq-9j8.16] Scope displayed delivery evidence to the current attempt
